svg.title: Two joint distributions with identical normal marginals and zero correlation
svg.desc: Left: samples from a bivariate standard normal with correlation zero, a round cloud; its mutual information is zero, so the coordinates are independent. Right: samples from an equal mixture of two bivariate normals with correlations plus and minus 0.9, an X shape; both coordinates are still standard normal and their correlation is still zero, but knowing one pins the other to two narrow bands, and the mutual information is about 0.41 nats.
svg.text: Both panels: X₁ ~ N(0,1), X₂ ~ N(0,1), corr(X₁, X₂) = 0. Only the joint shape differs.
